about: The portable Node.js the release bundles (tools/bin/node/node.exe, release-tools/make_release.js) and a source checkout downloads when it has no Node 20+ (setup/get_node.ps1, from setup\setup.bat). Official win-x64 zip of nodejs.org; zip_sha256 is the line of the release's SHASUMS256.txt; node_exe_sha256 is the node.exe inside it (release-tools/scan.js allows that binary by this hash).
